angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,001,808 km at 230.74 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.3338 +/- 0.0120 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 230.74 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.44 +/- 0.12 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,001,808 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.62 +/- 0.53 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6400 +/- 100 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-3.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.331, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+35 3293: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-3 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-3 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.43416, from Simpson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010MNRAS.405.1867S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-3 (pscomppars): age 2.1 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-3 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 13.4 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
